## Outcome firewall

No outcome member is read or emitted anywhere: the extractor never
touches `result`/`verdict`/`outcome` keys; `check_cost_only` +
`fold_packet` pass on every emitted record; PP0 rows carry
`{trial_ref, infra_failed, ag}` only (machinery/admission evidence);
injected outcome fields refuse typed (`MeasureErr::OutcomeLeak`).
